status: data fetched; split and methods not yet frozen
license_and_attribution: Vesuvius Challenge open data; check scrollprize.org data terms before redistribution
roi_selection_rule: first window aligned to the 128-px block grid, in row-major order, with maximal supervision coverage at 1/32 scale (100%); ink labels not used. An earlier search that used an ink-fraction filter was discarded.
axes_orientation: z = layer index of the flattened surface volume (65 layers), y/x = surface pixels

mask_semantics.ink: 255 = ink annotated; 0 = no ink (meaningful only where supervision = 255)
mask_semantics.supervision: 255 = pixel annotated and usable for scoring; 0 = excluded
mask_semantics.ink_layers: stored on layer 32 only (all 64 other layers are 0)
mask_semantics.supervision_layers: stored on layer 32 only (all 64 other layers are 0)
mask_semantics.provenance: annotations come from the reading work on this scroll; no separate validation mask is provided

label_registration_transform: none: labels and volume share the same zarr grid and chunking
